data.title: KSrelief Distributes 1,042 Food Baskets and Hygiene Kits to Earthquake-Affected People in Indonesia
data.content:
Jakarta, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) provided 521 food baskets and 521 personal hygiene kits on Thursday to residents of Reok District, Manggarai Regency, Flores Island, Indonesia, benefiting 2,084 individuals, as part of the relief aid distribution project for earthquake-affected people in Flores.
    The assistance comes within Saudi Arabia's ongoing humanitarian and relief projects and programs through KSrelief to provide necessities and improve the living and health conditions of people in need and those affected by crises around the world.
    -- SPA
21:24 Local Time 18:24 GMT
